create_mesh_from_catalog: create a Mesh from the MeshCatalog by name using create_mesh with an optional device
move_mesh_to_device: move a Mesh and all its tensors to a new device using the to method
load_mesh_vertices_or_faces: load mesh vertices or faces from a pickle file using load_mesh_data with a field name
get_geodesic_distances: get or compute geodesic distances between mesh vertices using the get_geodists method
load_mesh_symmetry_data: load mesh symmetry vertex transforms from a pickle file using load_mesh_symmetry with lru_cache
